Jonas / Marissa — thanks for the heads up. Quick finance checklist and answers:

1) Deposit approval: finance will sign off on a 50% deposit but we need a vendor invoice that references a Redwood PO number OR the AP email (ap@redwood.com). If you want a PO, Marissa should submit the PO request form with the vendor legal name exactly as on the W9.

2) Cost center coding: use cost center string "4302-Events-US" for this pop-up. For more granular tracking, include project tag "FW-PopUp-2027-05" in the PO notes column.

3) Travel advances: we can do employee advance payments up to $1,500 per person via Concur travel advances. For stipends paid to external contractors we prefer vendor invoice lines. If ambassadors are Redwood employees request travel via Concur and set profile to cost center 4302-Events-US. If you want us to pre-pay two stipends to MarketStreet we need line items on their estimate for 'Ambassador Travel Advance' and separate invoice.

4) Documents required: current W9 (we have the attached), certificate of insurance (COI), and vendor bank details or payment remittance form. Please upload to our vendor intake link so AP can create a PO quickly: https://redwood.atlassian.net/servicedesk/v1/vendor-intake

If Marissa sends the PO form today I can route and approve a PO number by end of day tomorrow.

-Aditya
Finance Manager, Redwood Inference
